segments.he: עַל שֶׁאֵין בָּהּ יְדִיעָה בַּתְּחִלָּה וְלֹא בַּסּוֹף, שְׂעִירֵי רְגָלִים וּשְׂעִירֵי רָאשֵׁי חֳדָשִׁים מְכַפְּרִין. דִּבְרֵי רַבִּי יְהוּדָה.
segments.en: § The mishna teaches: «For» the defiling of the Temple or its sacrificial foods «in which» one «did not have awareness,» neither «at the beginning nor at the end, the goats» brought as sin-offerings as part of the additional offerings «of the Festivals and the goats» brought as sin-offerings as part of the additional offerings «of» the «New Moons atone.» This is «the statement of Rabbi Yehuda.»
